basic_info.description: Welcome to 97 28th Street, a charming two-bedroom condo complete with a private one-car garage. This Edwardian era property blends classic character with modern convenience in the heart of Noe Valley. Built in 1924, this stylish corner condo is flooded with natural light and offers a flexible floor plan that can be used as a comfortable two-bedroom home or a generous one-bedroom with a formal dining room. The remodeled kitchen features a Viking range, stainless steel appliances, and stone countertops. Elegant period details include coved ceilings, picture and chair rails, wainscoting, crown molding, French doors, built-in cabinetry, and recently refinished hardwood floors. The in-unit laundry is conveniently located just off the kitchen. Enjoy serene, green outlooks of the iconic palm-lined Dolores Street and quick access to the shops and restaurants of Church Street, 24th Street, and the nearby Mission. Just two blocks to the J-Church Muni, with easy access to BART and major freeways, the location cannot be beat. Don't miss this sweet condominium with abundant storage in your own enclosed garage.
